accepted_contract_elements: No r1/r2 runtime, identity, credential, certificate, transaction, root or port is reusable.
A future actor is VehicleName-only and performs one WebSocket write followed by one ACK read with no retry or replay.
Authorization, exact binding/profile checks, one timestamp and an exclusive guard precede the single spawn.
A timeout, ACK mismatch, helper failure or downstream evidence failure is final and cleanup cannot authorize another call.
Hub owns any future fresh shared runtime, authorization, wrapper staging, ledger observation and cleanup.

blocking_findings.evidence: The proposal's exact helper and helper-test paths under /private/tmp/edge-fleet-src.current.x9MQxE are absent at review time.
blocking_findings.impact: Hub cannot independently rehash or inspect the exact source claimed for the future producer actor.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Provide stable host-side source and test paths with exact hashes and modes; do not rely on an expired temporary source root.

blocking_findings.evidence: The proposal cites only a historical wrapper path on a stopped guest and supplies placeholders and behavior requirements for the future wrapper, not a stable fresh wrapper implementation or focused tests.
blocking_findings.impact: The O_CREAT|O_EXCL, exact authorization, one-timestamp, one-spawn, timeout and atomic-result behavior cannot be independently reviewed before runtime staging.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Provide a stable source-only wrapper implementation and browser-free/no-network tests with exact hashes and modes.

next_gate: Edge supplies one additive superseding source-only package with stable helper source/test and fresh wrapper source/test identities. Hub then rehashes, inspects and runs only focused no-network guard checks before any fresh runtime decision.
proof_boundary: This review accepts the proposed policy shape but rejects execution readiness. It is not producer, forwarding, durable commit, ACK/frontier, projection, installation, service, release, production, vehicle or user acceptance evidence.
